synthesizedFacts.fact: Hyperpigmentation is caused by excess melanin production due to factors like sun exposure, hormonal changes, and skin injuries.
Topical treatments such as hydroquinone, retinoids, and face acids are effective first-line treatments for hyperpigmentation.
Photoprotection is crucial in managing hyperpigmentation, especially in individuals with skin of color.
Chemical peels and laser treatments can be effective but carry a risk of post-inflammatory hyperpigmentation, particularly in darker skin tones.
Localized hyperpigmentation can occur due to friction and is common in areas like elbows and knees.
